title: Family & Group Packages
subtitle: Exclusive deals for groups and families. Book together, save more — with free transport included!

trips.name: Cooking Masterclass Family Package
trips.description: An exclusive culinary journey for the whole family. Visit the vibrant Souk together, then learn the ancestral art of Tagine and Couscous with our traditional chef. Enjoy your creations with dessert and mint tea at Kasbat Souss artisan complex. 📍 Location: Kasbat Souss Artisan Complex. 🚐 Free transport included for your group.

trips.name: Quad Biking Family Package
trips.description: Feel the raw adrenaline together as a family! 2-hour off-road expedition across golden desert dunes with wind in your face and endless horizons ahead. 📍 Location: Beach & coastal dunes. 🚐 Free transport included for your group.

trips.name: Buggy Off-Road Family Package
trips.description: Conquer the desert together in brand-new, powerful buggys! 2 hours of pure off-road exhilaration across majestic sand dunes and spectacular desert trails. Adrenaline meets breathtaking scenery. 📍 Location: Agadir desert & sand dunes. 🚐 Free transport included for your group.

trips.name: Camel Trekking Family Package
trips.description: A magical desert journey at a gentle pace for the whole family. Traverse the ancient Aghroud forest trails, photograph the shimmering Souss River, and arrive at Kasbat Souss for an unforgettable Moroccan gathering with traditional mint tea, a sizzling BBQ feast, laughter, and lively activities. 📍 Location: Kasbat Souss & Aghroud forest. 🚐 Free transport included for your group.

trips.name: Pottery Workshop Family Package
trips.description: Immerse your family in the ancient art of Moroccan pottery. Work alongside skilled local artisans, shaping clay with your hands and learning centuries-old techniques. Create your own unique pieces to take home. After your creative session, celebrate with traditional mint tea, a sizzling BBQ feast, and joyful Moroccan atmosphere. 📍 Location: Kasbat Souss Artisan Complex. 🚐 Free transport included for your group.
